enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Tendon Slice +9: On Hit: 6% chance to slow target's movement by 50% for 9 seconds.
Electrifying 5: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 5d6 Lightning damage on each hit.
Freezing 12: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 12 to 72 Ice damage on each critical hit.
Armor-Piercing 17%: Passive: +17% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
